api.input_policy: Readonly outer records with exclusive fields. Constructor signature and runtime semantics unchanged.
api.coordinates: Resource local y-up to stage y-up; node rect is explicit stage clip/layout viewport; source rectangles use top-left image pixels.
api.ownership: Define on content change, publish references/cheap transforms, remove only after successful tree replacement drops the last reference. Pure renderItem cannot define/remove.
api.limits: 256 resources; host quad/string budgets; 16 MiB encoded bytes per resource, 32 MiB registry.
api.pixel_snap: Optional boolean, default false. Final physical-framebuffer axis edge rounding after transform, ties away from zero, then unchanged viewport clip; UVs unchanged. Requires b=c=0. Reflection and zero scale allowed; collapsed rectangles draw nothing. Canvas fallback and GPU support DPR-aware placement. Ordinary GPU f32 precision near half-pixel thresholds applies; no hidden epsilon.
api.native: New retained artwork and pixel snapping explicitly unsupported; inline unsnapped artwork retains existing native support.

completion.scope: Synchronous complete world/UI/cursor submissions. Not physical scanout. Query never ticks/pauses/decodes another world.
completion.scheduling: One RAF-owned fixed60 update/accept/draw transaction, sequential worker requests, capped catch-up/drop. Completion definitions unchanged; measure changed submissions as well as simulation and completed draws.

implementation.dynamic_artwork: Capacity-backed geometry per definition; consecutive texture groups with shared material, safe old-generation storage migration and bounded shrink.
implementation.saves: Private immutable save memory lease and worker changed-generation delta. Full inspection/replay values preserved. Reuse decoded frozen JSON and encoded storage string; startup/restart persist successfully before treating state as saved.
implementation.context: Retire explicit ordinary-world old-epoch GPU listeners/bindings while lost; retain CPU arrays/images and asset identity. Disabled particle export stub supplies the same lifecycle interface.
